Work Experience

@ Strat7 ResearchBods

During the August of 2026, I completed a week of Work Experience in the I.T Department of Strat7 ResearchBods.

Strat7 ResearchBods

Strat7

Strat7 is a global marketing research firm with many big profile customers, including but not limited to:

  • Jet2Holidays
  • Morrisons
  • Costa Coffee
  • Paramount
  • National Trust

During this time, I gained experience in Enterprise systems such as AvePoint Backup, HALO Ticketing, Basic Entra Operations, and recieved GDPR training during onboarding. I decommissioned broken and old laptops and catalogued storage devices for destruction. It was honestly, very very fun. The coffee machine was brilliant too.


Cheers, Rob!

title: CyberSwitchup
innerHTML:
CyberSwitchUp

In 2024, I attended the CyberSwitchUp competition, after being 'asked' (forced) to sign up by the Yorkshire & Humber Regional Organised Crime unit for the heinous crime of opening the UEFI on a school computer.

I placed 4th out of ~40 contestants, failing due to the incompetent environment, incorrectly set up systems and broken tasks, but still, 4th place is an achievement.

Tasks Completed:

  • O.S.I.N.T (Open Source Intelligence)
  • TCP Packet Decoding
  • Basic JavaScript Exploiting
  • Ate a Chicken Tikka wrap

Also, I had my Flipper Zero running the entire time broadcasting my website under the portal page of a network with the SSID of my GitHub username. Which was quite funny.
